body.intent: Fix Runs started agent sessions with a slash command whose skill was not installed, and those sessions sat idle, burning build attempts. After #521 (build role topics) merged at 03:06 on 2026-11-13, the root daemon auto-updated (rhiza.daemon.autoUpdate = main) to a binary whose builtin workflows start builders with /rhiza-builder and verifiers with /rhiza-verifier, but ~/.claude/skills/rhiza still held the older guide (rhiza-build, rhiza-plan, rhiza-review, rhiza-scrub; rhiza status already said 'Guide (user): out of date'). From 03:29 to 04:55, 16 sessions in runs 01M79EVFQQ, 01M79DZCC6 and 01M79DC5TX opened with Claude Code's 'Unknown command: /rhiza-builder' (12) or '/rhiza-verifier' (4) and never got their task; each cost a builder or verifier attempt (seen as 'builder fail'), and four were still idle at 04:55 (cb3bbb91, 3296ae2f, 3aff6de9, cac42031). Unstuck by the orchestrator: rhiza guide install --agent claude, then rhiza session message to each idle session with its original task. Wanted: (1) when the daemon re-executes a new binary, it refreshes the guide installs it finds out of date (or refuses to start agent steps whose skill is missing, with an inbox item naming rhiza guide install); (2) a session whose start command is unknown to the agent fails at once with that reason instead of sitting idle; (3) rhiza health warns while the installed guide is out of date.
